# Introduction

This notebook is intended to visualize the difference in MAPK scores among different cell types in the PA single nuc dataset. 

Then we will see if the same trends are observed in the imputed MAPK scores in the spatial dataset. If there are any spatially segregated niches by MAPK. 

The MAPK scores are here: `/data/beroukhim1/youyun/plgg/code/sc_integration/ENVI/2_spatial_imputation/MAPK_signatures.csv`

The ENVI objects are here: `/data/beroukhim1/youyun/plgg/data/sc_integration/ENVI_results`


# Load Data

## Load the MAPK scores

```{python}
gene_list = pd.read_csv(workdir+"youyun/plgg/code/sc_integration/ENVI/2_spatial_imputation/MAPK_signatures.csv")
```

## Load the AnnData object

```{python}
# List all files matching the pattern
sn_data = sorted(glob.glob(workdir + "youyun/plgg/data/sc_integration/ENVI_results/*astrocytoma_sn_envi.h5ad"))
spatial_data = sorted(glob.glob(workdir + "youyun/plgg/data/sc_integration/ENVI_results/*astrocytoma_spatial_envi.h5ad"))
```

# Looking at all MAPK scores

```{python}
for i in range(len(sn_data)):
    sample_name = re.sub('_',' ',re.sub('.*/|_sn_envi.*','',sn_data[i]))
    print('Processing Sample: ', sample_name)
    sn_adata = sc.read(sn_data[i])
    spatial_adata = sc.read(spatial_data[i])
    # create a new anndata object based on the imputed layer
    impute_adata = ad.AnnData(
        X=spatial_adata.obsm['imputation'],
        obs=spatial_adata.obs
    )

    # Assume gene_list is your DataFrame and sn_adata is your AnnData object
    for signature in gene_list['Signature'].unique():
        genes = gene_list.loc[gene_list['Signature'] == signature, 'Gene'].tolist()
        # Only keep genes present in the AnnData object
        genes_present = [g for g in genes if g in sn_adata.var_names]
        sc.tl.score_genes(sn_adata, gene_list=genes_present, score_name=f"{signature}_score", use_raw=False)
        sc.tl.score_genes(impute_adata, gene_list=genes_present, score_name=f"{signature}_imputed_score", use_raw=False)
        spatial_adata.obs[f"{signature}_imputed_score"] = impute_adata.obs[f"{signature}_imputed_score"]

    # plot the scores 
    with plt.rc_context({"figure.figsize": (6,3), "figure.dpi": (100)}):
        sc.pl.embedding(
            sn_adata, basis = 'latent_umap',
            color=[f"{signature}_score" for signature in gene_list['Signature'].unique()], 
            ncols=3, title = sample_name + " Single Nuclei UMAP: MAPK scores"
        )

    with plt.rc_context({"figure.figsize": (3,6), "figure.dpi": (100)}):
        sc.pl.stacked_violin(
            sn_adata, 
            var_names=[f"{signature}_score" for signature in gene_list['Signature'].unique()], 
            groupby='annot_v1', 
            title = sample_name + " Single Nuclei MAPK scores by Cell Type"
        )

    with plt.rc_context({"figure.figsize": (6,3), "figure.dpi": (100)}):
        sc.pl.embedding(
            spatial_adata, basis = 'latent_umap',
            color=[f"{signature}_imputed_score" for signature in gene_list['Signature'].unique()], 
            ncols=3, title = sample_name + " Spatial UMAP: Imputed MAPK scores"
        )

    with plt.rc_context({"figure.figsize": (3,6), "figure.dpi": (100)}):
        sc.pl.stacked_violin(
            spatial_adata, 
            var_names=[f"{signature}_imputed_score" for signature in gene_list['Signature'].unique()], 
            groupby='Fine.Cell.Type.UMAP', 
            title = sample_name + " Spatial Imputed MAPK scores by Cell Type"
        )

    with plt.rc_context({"figure.figsize": (6,3), "figure.dpi": (100)}):
        sc.pl.embedding(
            spatial_adata, basis = 'spatial',
            color=[f"{signature}_imputed_score" for signature in gene_list['Signature'].unique()], 
            ncols=3, title = sample_name + " Spatial Plot of Imputed MAPK scores"
        )

```


# Focusing on only the MAPK overlap score

```{python}
def visualize_results(st_data, sc_data, sample_name):
    
    # ========== ENVI embedding ==========
    lim_arr = np.concatenate([st_data.obsm['latent_umap'], sc_data.obsm['latent_umap']], axis = 0)

    delta = 1
    pre = 0.1
    xmin = np.percentile(lim_arr[:, 0], pre) - delta
    xmax = np.percentile(lim_arr[:, 0], 100 - pre) + delta
    ymin = np.percentile(lim_arr[:, 1], pre) - delta
    ymax = np.percentile(lim_arr[:, 1], 100 - pre) + delta
    
    fig = plt.figure(figsize = (13,8))
    plt.subplot(121)
    sns.scatterplot(x = sc_data.obsm['latent_umap'][:, 0], y = sc_data.obsm['latent_umap'][:, 1], 
                    hue = sc_data.obs['annot_v1'], palette = 'tab20', s = 8,
                    legend = True)
    legend = plt.legend(title = 'Cell Type', prop={'size': 12}, fontsize = '12',  markerscale = 3, ncol = 1, bbox_to_anchor = (1, 1))#, loc = 'lower left')
    plt.title("scRNA-seq Latent")
    plt.xlim([xmin, xmax])
    plt.ylim([ymin, ymax])
    plt.axis('off')

    plt.subplot(122)
    sns.scatterplot(x = st_data.obsm['latent_umap'][:, 0], y = st_data.obsm['latent_umap'][:, 1],  
                    hue = st_data.obs['cell_type'], palette = 'tab20', s = 8, 
                    legend = True)

    legend = plt.legend(title = 'Cell Type', prop={'size': 12}, fontsize = '12',  markerscale = 3, ncol = 1, bbox_to_anchor = (1, 1))#, loc = 'lower left')

    plt.setp(legend.get_title(),fontsize='12')
    plt.title("Xenium Latent")
    plt.axis('off')
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.xlim([xmin, xmax])
    plt.ylim([ymin, ymax])
    # total plot title
    plt.suptitle("ENVI Latent UMAP " + sample_name, fontsize=16, y=1.02)
    plt.subplots_adjust(top=0.85)  # Adjust the top margin to make room for the title
    plt.show()
    
    # ========== spatial sample vis =========
    fig = plt.figure(figsize = (13,8))
    sns.scatterplot(x = st_data.obsm['spatial'][:, 0], y = st_data.obsm['spatial'][:, 1],  
                    hue = st_data.obs['cell_type'], palette = 'tab20', s = 8, 
                    legend = True)

    legend = plt.legend(title = 'Cell Type', prop={'size': 12}, fontsize = '12',  markerscale = 3, ncol = 1, bbox_to_anchor = (1, 1))#, loc = 'lower left')

    plt.setp(legend.get_title(),fontsize='12')
    plt.title("Xenium Spatial " + sample_name)
    plt.axis('off')
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```

```{python}
# set up a data frame of columns: sample, cell id, single nuc or spatial, cell types, MAPK_overlap_score
mapk_scores = pd.DataFrame(columns=['sample', 'type', 'cell_type', 'MAPK_overlap_score'])
for i in range(len(sn_data)):
    sample_name = re.sub('_',' ',re.sub('.*/|_sn_envi.*','',sn_data[i]))
    print('Processing Sample: ', sample_name)
    sn_adata = sc.read(sn_data[i])
    spatial_adata = sc.read(spatial_data[i])
    # calculate the frequency of each cell type within the spatial data
    cell_type_counts = spatial_adata.obs['Fine.Cell.Type.UMAP'].value_counts(normalize=True)
    # Identify categories that are less than 1% or are NA
    low_frequency_types = cell_type_counts[cell_type_counts < 0.01].index
    # Replace these categories with 'other'
    spatial_adata.obs['cell_type'] = spatial_adata.obs['Fine.Cell.Type.UMAP'].apply(
        lambda x: 'other' if pd.isna(x) or x in low_frequency_types else x
    )
    spatial_adata.obs['cell_type'] = spatial_adata.obs['cell_type'].fillna('other')

    # plot out the joint embedding space and color by cell type
    visualize_results(spatial_adata, sn_adata, sample_name)
    
    # create a new anndata object based on the imputed layer
    impute_adata = ad.AnnData(
        X=spatial_adata.obsm['imputation']
    )

    # MAPK_overlap
    genes = gene_list.loc[gene_list['Signature'] == 'MAPK_overlap', 'Gene'].tolist()
    genes_present = [g for g in genes if g in sn_adata.var_names]
    sc.tl.score_genes(sn_adata, gene_list=genes_present, score_name=f"MAPK_overlap_score", use_raw=False)
    sc.tl.score_genes(impute_adata, gene_list=genes_present, score_name=f"MAPK_overlap_imputed_score", use_raw=False)
    spatial_adata.obs[f"MAPK_overlap_imputed_score"] = impute_adata.obs[f"MAPK_overlap_imputed_score"]

    # plot the scores on the umap
    with plt.rc_context({"figure.figsize": (6,4), "figure.dpi": (100)}):
        sc.pl.embedding(
            sn_adata, basis = 'latent_umap',
            color=["MAPK_overlap_score"], 
            title = sample_name + " Single Nuclei UMAP: MAPK Overlap Score"
        )

    with plt.rc_context({"figure.figsize": (6,4), "figure.dpi": (100)}):
        sc.pl.embedding(
            spatial_adata, basis = 'latent_umap',
            color=["MAPK_overlap_imputed_score"], 
            title = sample_name + " Spatial UMAP: Imputed MAPK Overlap Score"
        )

    # plot the scores by cell type on the x axis 
    with plt.rc_context({"figure.figsize": (10,3), "figure.dpi": (100)}):
        ax = sc.pl.violin(
            sn_adata, keys=["MAPK_overlap_score"], 
            groupby='annot_v1', rotation=90, show = False
        ) 
        plt.title(sample_name + " Single Nuclei MAPK Overlap Score by Cell Type")
        plt.show()

    with plt.rc_context({"figure.figsize": (10,3), "figure.dpi": (100)}):
        ax = sc.pl.violin(
            spatial_adata, keys=["MAPK_overlap_imputed_score"],
            groupby='cell_type', rotation=90, show = False
        )
        plt.title(sample_name + " Spatial Imputed MAPK Overlap Score by Cell Type")
        plt.show()

    # plot the scores on the spatial plot
    with plt.rc_context({"figure.figsize": (6,4), "figure.dpi": (100)}):
        sc.pl.embedding(
            spatial_adata, basis = 'spatial',
            color=["MAPK_overlap_imputed_score"], 
            title = sample_name + " Spatial Plot of Imputed MAPK Overlap Score"
        )

    # append the scores to the data frame
    mapk_scores = pd.concat([
        mapk_scores, 
        pd.DataFrame({
            'sample': sample_name, 'type': 'spatial',
            'cell_id': spatial_adata.obs_names,
            'cell_type': spatial_adata.obs['Fine.Cell.Type.UMAP'],
            'MAPK_overlap_score': spatial_adata.obs['MAPK_overlap_imputed_score']
        })
    ], ignore_index=True)
    mapk_scores = pd.concat([
        mapk_scores, 
        pd.DataFrame({
            'sample': sample_name, 'type': 'sn',
            'cell_id': sn_adata.obs_names,
            'cell_type': sn_adata.obs['annot_v1'],
            'MAPK_overlap_score': sn_adata.obs['MAPK_overlap_score']
        })
    ], ignore_index=True)

# Save the MAPK scores
mapk_scores.to_csv(workdir + "youyun/plgg/code/sc_integration/ENVI/2_spatial_imputation/PA/MAPK_overlap_scores.csv", index=False)
```
